## Observed mechanism
PreToolUse story write fence (loadStoryWriteFenceFromMergeBase → selectBaseRefForFence) picks base as DEFT_BASE_REF / GITHUB_BASE_REF then hardcoded origin/master|main|master|main. It never consults typed plan.policy.deliveryBranch (#5520).
scope-provenance resolveDefaultBaseRef already inserts origin/<deliveryBranch> after env and before master|main. Consumer develop-delivery repos activate briefs on develop; merge-base(HEAD, origin/main) lacks that brief → empty/missing fence → positive-governing / prospective scope-cover refuse.

## Bound remedy (draft limbs; bind after Round-1)
- relieves: P1 — Teach selectBaseRefForFence to prefer typed plan.policy.deliveryBranch (origin/<branch> then branch) after env overrides and before hardcoded master|main, mirroring scope-provenance resolveDefaultBaseRef via resolveDeliveryBranch.
- relieves: P2 — Include the selected baseRef (and typed delivery when used) in write-fence unreadable / no-base copy and in prospective scope-cover messages that surface fence emptiness or unreadableDetail so the refusal names which base was read.
- relieves: P1 — Extend the process-local merge-base memo key with the resolved delivery candidate so a typed deliveryBranch change cannot reuse a stale main memo in-process.
- relieves: P1 — Add write-fence tests: typed deliveryBranch=develop loads fence from merge-base with origin/develop when the brief exists only there; unset deliveryBranch keeps master|main behavior; env DEFT_BASE_REF still wins.

## Reject
- Reading working-tree HEAD brief as fence authority (#4956 merge-base SoT stays).
- Making DEFT_BASE_REF the only supported consumer fix (typed delivery must work without per-shell env).
- Softening #5656 git commit -a / pathspec / compound refuses (intentional index-snapshot gate; out of this Bound).
- Importing scope-provenance into policy/write-fence (use resolveDeliveryBranch in-policy; optional later shared helper leftover).

## In plain English

**Verdict: sharpen Prefer-A.** The pinned code confirms P1: the fence selector skips the configured delivery branch. The existing in-policy resolver is the thin fix. P2 also needs a small data-flow change: an empty fence currently loses the base name before the commit gate renders its refusal.

Reviewed the issue body and mandatory comments 6663229272, 6663229715, 6663248299, and 6663248735 only; inclusive ceiling 6663248735. Verification used git show 7f04a43075911dcacf72683e0e886152b8bc2fe8: for all four named source files. No sibling critic posts read.

### F1 — Medium / sharpens-framing — Carry base context through empty results

Evidence: [write-fence.ts](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/7f04a43075911dcacf72683e0e886152b8bc2fe8/packages/core/src/policy/write-fence.ts): StoryWriteFenceView carries only allow/deny arrays and optional unreadableDetail. loadStoryWriteFenceFromMergeBase retains resolved.baseRef in its cache key but drops it from the returned successful/empty view. [dispatcher.ts](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/7f04a43075911dcacf72683e0e886152b8bc2fe8/packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts): evaluateProspectiveScopeCover forwards unreadableDetail but constructs the empty-positive-allow refusal itself.

Failure mode: loader error-string edits alone leave the ordinary missing-brief/empty-file_scope refusal without its selected base, so P2 remains. Turning a readable empty fence into an unreadable error just to transport text changes semantics for other callers.

Consequence: keep the P2 limb, explicitly carry optional selected-base context on the existing fence view, including cached empty results, and render it in the dispatcher refusal. Add dispatcher and its relevant tests to file_scope. If selection fails entirely, report no selected ref and attempted candidates rather than claiming a base was read. This is data plumbing, not another evaluator.

### F2 — Medium / sharpens-framing — Preserve the typed-only guard

Evidence: [resolveDefaultBaseRef](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/7f04a43075911dcacf72683e0e886152b8bc2fe8/packages/core/src/scope-provenance/evaluate.ts) inserts delivery candidates only for source === "typed", error === null, and a nonempty branch. [resolveDeliveryBranch](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/7f04a43075911dcacf72683e0e886152b8bc2fe8/packages/core/src/policy/delivery-branch.ts) also returns git-default/default-fallback results; its git default can prefer main while the existing fence fallback prefers master.

Failure mode: unconditionally inserting the returned branch changes unset-policy behavior when main and master coexist, contradicting the compatibility promise.

Consequence: state the existing typed-success guard explicitly. Verify unset policy with both refs present, local-only develop, and both environment override forms. Do not expand this patch into a shared resolver refactor or a new invalid-policy fallback policy.

### F3 — Low / sharpens-framing — Test policy changes without clearing the memo

Evidence: resolveMergeBaseCommitForFence consults its five-second process-local memo, keyed by root and environment, before selecting a base. The fence-load memo already includes baseRef and immutable SHA.

Failure mode: separate fresh-process develop/main tests can pass while a same-process delivery-policy change still returns the old fence.

Consequence: retain the first-memo key change and add one regression that loads with unset policy, changes typed delivery to develop, and loads again within the TTL without clearing memos. Reuse the same resolved typed candidate for the key and selection; no broader cache redesign is needed.

The rejected shared-helper approach offers eventual deduplication, but adds cross-module scope without improving these two pains. Keep immutable merge-base brief authority and all intentional #5656 command-form refusals intact.

## In plain English
The Prefer-A draft correctly targets the real bug: write-fence base selection skips typed `plan.policy.deliveryBranch`, so develop-delivery repos merge-base against main and see an empty story fence. The Bound can bind after two sharpens: (1) insert delivery candidates only under the same typed+error-null gate `resolveDefaultBaseRef` already uses, and (2) surface the selected baseRef on the successful empty-fence path that feeds positive-governing / prospective refuses — wrong-base misses are empty, not unreadable.

Verdict on Prefer-A: **sharpen**

## Findings

### F1 — Typed-only delivery insert must mirror resolveDefaultBaseRef gate
- severity: medium
- class: sharpens-framing
- evidence: pin-read `packages/core/src/scope-provenance/evaluate.ts` `resolveDefaultBaseRef` inserts `origin/<branch>` then `branch` only when `delivery.source === "typed" && delivery.error === null && delivery.branch.trim().length > 0`. `resolveDeliveryBranch` returns `source: "git-default" | "default-fallback" | "default-on-error"` with a branch string in non-typed cases, and returns `source: "typed"` with `branch: ""` plus error when the typed name fails `assertSafeBranchName`. pin-read `selectBaseRefForFence` today has no delivery consult.
- failure mode: a Bound that always pushes `resolveDeliveryBranch().branch` into the candidate list would reorder master|main probing for repos with no typed delivery, or probe an empty ref when typed policy is hostile — changing fail-closed association beyond P1.
- disposition: keep limb 1; state the typed+error-null+non-empty gate explicitly (same as #5520), still via in-policy `resolveDeliveryBranch` without importing scope-provenance.

### F2 — Wrong-base miss is empty fence; baseRef must ride the success path
- severity: medium
- class: sharpens-framing
- evidence: pin-read `loadStoryWriteFenceFromMergeBase` → missing brief on the resolved merge-base commit yields `raw.kind === "missing"` → `loadStoryWriteFenceFromBaseRaw(null)` → `{ fileScope: [], denyPaths: [] }` with no `unreadableDetail`. `evaluateProspectiveScopeCover` then denies via `hasPositiveGoverningStoryAllow` with copy that names neither baseRef nor delivery (`selected scope lacks positive governing allow file_scope`). Issue body and Stop 1 P1/P2 describe exactly this empty/missing-fence refuse, not only unreadableDetail. Merge-base compute failure already interpolates `${baseRef}` in one unreadable path; the consumer-visible empty path does not.
- failure mode: limb 2 scoped only to unreadable/no-base helpers leaves P2 unrelieved on the primary develop-delivery refuse path; operators still cannot see main-vs-develop mismatch when the fence loads "successfully" empty.
- disposition: keep limb 2; require selected baseRef (and typed delivery when used) to be available after a successful merge-base resolve — including empty file_scope — and named in positive-governing / prospective empty-fence refuse copy. Do not invent HEAD-brief authority.

### F3 — Memo key + tests + Reject list
- severity: low
- class: footnote
- evidence: pin-read memo key is `${projectRoot}\0${envKey}` only (DEFT_BASE_REF|GITHUB_BASE_REF); no delivery component. Reject list correctly keeps #4956 merge-base SoT, keeps #5656 `-a`/pathspec/compound refuses, and bars scope-provenance import.
- failure mode: none material if F1/F2 land; memo limb already relieves stale main reuse after typed delivery appears mid-process.
- disposition: accept limbs 3–4 and Reject as written; CHANGELOG/docs stay footnotes.

## Road-not-taken
Shared helper extracted from `resolveDefaultBaseRef` into policy/ — rejected for this Bound (Prefer-A Reject already says optional leftover). In-policy `resolveDeliveryBranch` + mirrored gate is thinner and relieves P1 without a cross-package move.

## Injection / swarm lens
Base-ref selection is shared hook state for Write and prospective git-commit cover. Env overrides remain first (CI-safe). Typed delivery after env matches scope-provenance order. No new trust in untrusted brief bytes; merge-base SoT unchanged. Do not soften intentional #5656 index-snapshot refuses.

## Accept / sharpen / block
**sharpen** Prefer-A draft 6663229272 — bind after absorbing F1 (typed-only gate) and F2 (success-path baseRef on empty-fence refuse). Bound stays thin (#3265 / #5783).

metadata.issueBody:
Found on 0.129.1 in a consumer repo whose delivery branch is `develop` (default branch `main`).

**What happens.** The PreToolUse commit gate (prospective scope-cover, #5656) reads the story's `file_scope` from the merge-base of HEAD and `origin/main` (unless `DEFT_BASE_REF` / `GITHUB_BASE_REF` is set in the hook's environment). A scope brief that is activated on `develop` is not on that base, so the gate refuses the commit ("no scope" / "lacks file_scope") even though the brief is active and correct on the branch being worked on.

It also rejects `git commit -a`, trailing pathspecs, pipes and add+commit compounds, each with a different message.

**Impact.** The only way forward was a separate activation PR merged first, then rebasing. For a repo with a develop -> main model, every story needs that extra round trip.

**Suggested fix.** Resolve the base from the repo's configured delivery branch (the same source `verify:branch` uses) instead of assuming `origin/main`, and say in the refusal which base it read.

Observed 2026-10-27/28 during the 0.127.0 -> 0.129.1 upgrade of one consumer repo.

expected_outputs: baseRef on StoryWriteFenceView + empty-fence refuse copy
